I know I am number 6,731,429 to post something about this. 
We just moved to the FL panhandle, and I am VERY unfamiliar with the area and options. My daughter is 5. She’s been in pageants her whole life, but we’re wanting to see about taking it a step further with an agency. Willing to drive up to 8ish hours for the right opportunities, too! I know most agencies want you within a 3-4 hour drive from their location, but figured we would shoot our shot to see if anyone had any insight. Any help is appreciated!

Google agencies in your area that work with kids in this age. Submit photos and if they are interested, they will be in contact.

CASTING CALL

Memory Box is searching for a a lead female actress with a playing age of early 20s. 

All information is on the post, but if there is any questions please shoot an email to eleonoragrace07@gmail.com and I'll get back to you ASAP.

Please apply by the 10th of September 2026, shoot dates will be mid/late November 2026.

Memory Box is an independent short film focusing on mental health, nostalgia, and human connection, written by published poet Eleonora Grace.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

attachments.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'CASTING CALL: LEAD FEMALE ACTRESS PROJECT: PROJECT TITLE: Memory Box POAST FORMAT: Short Film (Independent/Passion Project) FILMING DATES: Mid/Late November 2026 LOCATION: Liverpool City Region COMPENSATION: Unpaid (Full credit, catering and travel covered, reel footage provided) CASTING DETAILS NEXT PAGE Please send your headshot, an acting cV/spotlight link or showreel, as well a a self tape information on next page) to: eleonoragrace07@gmail.com'

May be a graphic of text that says 'CHARACTER PROFILE: •Playing age of early 20s •Quiet, deeply reflective, carrying heavy emotional weight ROAST KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Deliver intense, vulnerable emotional beats across multiple takes Work closely with the director to tap into the specific nuanced tone of the character's sorrow •Maintain the heavy, somber physicial presence required for the character throughout the shoot dates REQUIREMENTS: ·Must be able to cry on command convincingly •Highly skilled at storytelling through micro- expressions and posture without relying on dialogue •Ability to accuratly convey deep despressive moods, internal conflict, and nostalgia'

May be a doodle of ‎text that says '‎가게 工 حسه hall مه si Hoi H there SELF TAPE PROMPT: POAST ·Holding a small significant object in your hands (ie photograph) look down at it and let the realisation of what it represents slowly break throught the numbness •Without moving or making a sound, let your posture and eyes convey a heavy wave of depression and nostalgia show the internal struggle Allow yourself to completely breakdown we need to see a genuine vulnerable transition into tears this shouldn't be a theatrical sob, it needs to be quiet and devistating- hold this for 10-15 seconds Dior‎'‎

🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬
[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min)  👇

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1efo6oTR_i48qKapW9l9PgFkhNzdgRkIF/view?usp=drivesdk

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ SCAR (mężczyzna, 24 lata) – charyzmatyczny, energiczny, wyluzowany, kocha ryzyko i adrenalinę.

2️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie.

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

3️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Trenuje sporty walki i maluje graffiti.

4️⃣ GAJA (kobieta, 23 lata) – opanowana, zdystansowana tatuatorka. Ma sarkastyczne poczucie humoru.

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI  👇

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BIJgru47_mymjk5LL49I-qX80mRdcU3D_BOEfu7MWLc/mobilebasic

items.text:
🎙️ **Deutscher männlicher Sprecher / Creator für regelmäßigen YouTube-Kanal gesucht**

Ich suche einen **muttersprachlichen deutschen Sprecher** für einen neuen YouTube-Kanal über **Finanzbetrug, Wirtschaftsskandale, Ponzi-Systeme und außergewöhnliche Kriminalfälle**.

Die Videos werden meist ca. **25–40 Minuten** lang sein. Das fertige deutsche Skript wird von mir geliefert.

Gesucht wird:
* männliche deutsche Stimme
* natürliche, ruhige und spannende Erzählweise
* saubere Audioaufnahme
* zusätzlich eine einfache Videoaufnahme während des Sprechens

Das Video kann ganz unkompliziert mit dem **Smartphone** aufgenommen werden. Idealerweise seitlich bzw. im 3/4-Winkel, sodass Gesicht und Mund sichtbar sind. Professionelle Kamera oder aufwendige Videoproduktion sind nicht nötig.

Es geht um eine **regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit**.

💶 Budget für die ersten Folgen: ca. **30–50 € pro Episode**.
Auch Anfänger, Schauspieler, UGC-Creator oder angehende Sprecher sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Bei Interesse bitte gerne eine kurze Sprachprobe oder einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten per PN schicken.

Beispiel für den gewünschten Stil / die Einbindung des Sprechers:
[https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ](https://youtu.be/R64LEScn3-Q?is=NozwUDMY1udxFFQZ)

🔥 PROMOTER / SALES PERSON WANTED — GERMANY & FRANCE

We are looking for outgoing sales promoters to work with our tattoo team at conventions and events in Germany and France.

Your job:
• Approach visitors and start conversations
• Present our offers and tattoo artists
• Work with objections
• Convert visitors into clients/bookings

We are looking for:
• Strong communication and sales skills
• Confident approaching strangers
• Experience in direct sales, promotion or events is a big advantage
• German + English for Germany
• French + English for France
• Russian/Ukrainian is a bonus, but not required

📍 Work at tattoo conventions and events
💰 Fixed payment + sales bonus
📅 Freelance / weekend projects throughout the year

If interested, send a short introduction, city, languages, sales/event experience and Instagram/LinkedIn or photo in DM.

Hi, ich bin **Berhane Berhane**, Comedian, Schauspieler, Entertainer und Moderator aus München. 

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **neuen Jobs, Castings und spannenden Projekten im Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Entertainmentbereich**.

 **Schauspiel – Deutsch & Englisch**
Meine **Schauspielausbildung habe ich in den USA absolviert** und selbst einige Zeit in **Los Angeles** gelebt. Dadurch kann ich Rollen sowohl **auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch** spielen und bin auch für internationale bzw. englischsprachige Produktionen einsetzbar.

 **Comedy, Moderation & Entertainment**
Als Comedian bringe ich langjährige Bühnenerfahrung, Timing, Improvisation und Spontaneität mit. Zusätzlich werde ich regelmäßig als **Moderator und DJ** für Veranstaltungen gebucht.

 **Action, Kampfsport & Stunts**
Ich habe **Thaiboxen und Kung-Fu** trainiert und kann bei entsprechenden Produktionen auch körperliche Rollen und Stunts selbst übernehmen.

 **Fitness, Tanz & Bewegung**
Durch meine **Trainer-C-Lizenz im Fitness- und Tanzbereich** kann ich ebenfalls für Produktionen eingesetzt werden, bei denen Fitness, Tanz, Bewegung oder Choreografie gefragt sind.

 **Snowboard**
Seit **über 25 Jahren arbeite ich als Snowboardlehrer** und bringe entsprechend viel Erfahrung auf dem Board mit. Damit bin ich auch für Film-, TV-, Werbe- und Actionproduktionen im Wintersportbereich interessant.

**Mein Profil:**
 Schauspiel Deutsch & Englisch
 Comedy & Improvisation
 Moderation & Entertainment
 DJ
 Thaiboxen & Kung-Fu
 Action & Stunts
 Fitness & Tanz
 Über 25 Jahre Erfahrung als Snowboardlehrer

 **Casting-Agenturen, Produktionsfirmen, Regisseure & Veranstalter:**
Wenn ihr für euer nächstes Projekt einen vielseitigen Darsteller und Entertainer sucht, freue ich mich über eure Nachricht. **Ich bin offen für Castings, Drehs, Werbung, TV, Film und neue spannende Projekte.**

Gerne teilen & weiterempfehlen. 

**Berhane Berhane**

📅 Wednesday 9th September 2026⏰ 4:30pm – 6:30pm📍 Gatley Hill House, Church Road, Gatley, Stockport, SK8 4EY

🌐 Find out more about Manchester Youth Film School:

🎬 CASTING CALL – OFFIZIELLES MUSIKVIDEO „TITTEN & BIER“ 🍺☀️

Für das offizielle Musikvideo zur neuen Party-Single „Titten & Bier“ von Ricky Leroy suchen wir gut gelaunte Menschen, die Lust auf einen sommerlichen Drehtag voller Party-Atmosphäre haben.

Das Projekt:
Es handelt sich umein unabhängiges Low-Budget-Musikvideoprojekt. 

Daher können wir leider keinebranchenübliche Gage zahlen. Als Dank für deine Zeit erhältst du eine Aufwandsentschädigung von 75 €, kostenlose Getränke sowie dein persönliches Footage für Showreel oder Social Media.

Wen wir suchen:
Wir suchen Personenab 18 Jahren für eine ausgelassene Poolparty-Szene.

Wichtig: Alle Bewerber*innen müssen mindestens 18 Jahre alt sein. Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – gute Laune und Lust auf einen Drehtag stehen im Vordergrund.

Das erwartet euch:
🏖️ Sommerliche Poolparty-Atmosphäre
🎶 Musik, Tanzen und gute Stimmung
🍺 Kostenlose Getränke
💶 Snacks

Über den Song:
Mit „Titten & Bier“ liefert Ricky Leroy einen energie geladenen Party-Song im Mallorca- und Ballermann-Stil. Der Titel steht für Sommer, Feiern, gute Freunde und jede Menge gute Laune – mit eingängigen Beats, amerikanischem Akzent und einemAugenzwinkern.

Dresscode:
👙 Bikini
🩱 Badeanzug
🩳 Badehose
😎 Sommerliche Party-Outfits

Drehtag:
📅 15.08.2026
🕙 Anfangszeit 10 Uhr bis zum 20 Uhr 10.08.2026

📍 Der genaue Drehort wird spätestens bis zum 10.08.2026 

Bewerbung:
Bitte sende uns perE-Mail:
    * ein aktuelles Foto
    * deinen Namen
    * dein Alter
    * deine Handynummer
    * optional: dein Instagram- oder TikTok-Profil

E-Mail: diodoublegeerecords@gmail.com

Wir freuen uns aufdeine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam mit dir ein stimmungsvolles Musikvideo zuproduzieren. 🍻☀️

#rickyleroy #malle #musikvideo #partyschlager #casting

DDO vs Coast to Coast
Hello everyone,

I hope your days are going lovely and if you’re starting school soon that the summer is winding down smoothly. It’s insanity over here haha.

I had a question for anyone that’s worked with DDO or Cosst to Coast. My daughter’s are currently signed with Coast to Coast in their commercial division. They haven’t been sent much but honestly a lot of their resume and experience has been on stage. They are both in musical theater conservatory, my oldest for the past three years, and are on competitive mt jazz, tap and hiphop teams. They also both are in private vocal lessons. So much is focused on performing on stage that I’m wondering if maybe there isn’t a better fit at DDO for them?

What’s been your experience? 

These are my girls 🥹 thanks for any and all insight!

topComments.text: We just signed with Coast to Coast! My son is 14 and a musical theater kid. We switched agents because MT dries up for teen boys and wanted an LA focus for film/tv. 🤞🏻My extensive research, however, would say that if your girls want that field, you are best with NYC agency with deep ties to casting agents Telsey and Tara Rubin. My son was with Carson Adler and got lots of great MT opportunities including getting cast on a national tour. Good luck!
Or if your child is doing stage/broadway and film where are you represented or what have you found works well in your reels?

🎵 Szukamy prowadzących zajęcia muzyczne dla dzieci 🎵

📍 Warszawa · Łódź · Gdańsk · Wrocław · Poznań 

Akademia Bachmana prowadzi zajęcia muzyczne w żłobkach i przedszkolach: prowadzący plus muzyk grający na żywo, 30 minut, gotowy scenariusz. Reszta to Wasza inwencja. Na sezon 2026/2027 szukamy osób do trzech typów zajęć:

🎼 audycje muzyczne — opowieść o muzyce i kontakt z dziećmi, prezentacja instrumentu 
🎭 zajęcia musicalowe — śpiew, ruch, praca nad małą formą sceniczną
🗣️ English Music — zajęcia prowadzone w całości po angielsku

Kogo szukamy?
✔️ wykształcenia muzycznego, wokalnego, aktorskiego, tanecznego lub pedagogicznego
✔️ swobody w pracy z maluchami — i odwagi, żeby zaczarować salę
✔️ prawa jazdy kat. B oraz zaświadczenia o niekaralności
➕ atutem są: metoda E. E. Gordona, doświadczenie musicalowe lub teatralne, a przy English Music angielski na poziomie min. B2

Co oferujemy?
🔹 pracę od poniedziałku do piątku w godzinach porannych — bez wieczorów i weekendów
🔹 firmowe auto i zwrot kosztów dojazdu
🔹 gotowy grafik ustalony na cały sezon
🔹 bezpłatne wejścia na wydarzenia, które organizujemy

Mark Your Calendar!!/NOW CASTING both AEA and non-union talent!!
SG Casting is casting The Lone Tree Arts Center’s production of Amadeus in Lone Tree, Colorado!

Both local and non-local talent are encouraged to submit an audition!

AEA audition sign ups will open on Monday, August 17th.

Non-AEA audition sign ups will open on Wednesday, August 26th.

If you are local, please sign up for an in-person audition if possible.  

If you are not local, please plan to submit a video audition. 

The Lone Tree Arts Center’s Executive Director is Leigh Chandler.

LORT D Contract

Weekly Rate:

$950.00 minimum for Principals and Understudies/Swings

Director: Geoffrey Kent

Executive Director: Leigh Chandler

Casting Director: Sylvia Gregory, CSA

All above creative team members will be present at auditions and viewing audition videos.

In Person Initial Auditions: Monday September 14th and Tuesday September 15th.

In Person Callbacks: Monday October 5th; will add Tuesday October 6th if needed.

Video general auditions are due by Friday September 11th..

Video callbacks are due by Friday, October 2nd.

First Rehearsal - 3/16/27

Tech Starts - 3/31/27

Invited Rehearsals - 4/7/27

Opening - 4/8/27

Closing - 4/18/27

General Audition Requirements:

Please prepare one monologue or two contrasting monologues not to exceed 3 minutes total.

For in-person and video auditions:

In person auditions are by appointment only. Sign up, upload headshots and resumes, and/or submit your videos all at this link: 

https://www.lonetreeartscenter.org/amadeusauditions

Headshot and Resume are REQUIRED to be uploaded into Production Tools.

Do not contact members of the production teams. If you have any questions, contact Saundra Bergman at Saundra.Bergman@cityoflonetree.com.

The Lone Tree Arts Center is committed to diversity and maintains a policy of equal employment opportunity designed to promote a positive model of inclusion. As such, we encourage performers of all ethnicities, gender identities, body types and sizes, and ages, as well as performers with disabilities, to audition for appropriate roles.

The Lone Tree Arts Center creates a safe and equitable workplace through policies defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the Actors’ Equity Association, and the City of Lone Tree. These policies provide a comprehensive framework for health and safety of all actors, stage managers, creative staff, and designers employed by The Lone Tree Arts Center.

Information and Character Breakdown

CASTING NOTE:

Antonio Salieri and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart will be cast with male-presenting performers. Constanze Weber will be cast with a female-identifying performer, as the character is pregnant at one point in the play. 

All other roles are open to performers of any gender. Performers of all genders and gender expressions are encouraged to audition. 

Character genders, pronouns, relationships, and historical identities will remain as written in the script; performers will not be asked to portray a gender different from their own.

Roles:

ANTONIO SALIERI, male-presenting, 50 to 65

Court Composer to the Emperor. Brilliant, ambitious, and deeply conflicted, he serves as narrator while recounting his lifelong rivalry with Mozart. Exceptional command of language and emotional range required.

WOLFGANG AMADEUS MOZART, male-presenting, 25 to 35

A musical genius with boundless wit, irreverence, and youthful energy. Mercurial, funny, and deeply vulnerable beneath his exuberance.

CONSTANZE WEBER MOZART, female-presenting, 20 to 35 

Mozart’s devoted wife. Intelligent, resilient, and fiercely practical as she struggles to support her husband and family. Role will also include Ensemble work.

EMPEROR JOSEPH II, 35 to 55 

Emperor of Austria. Affable, curious, and genuinely devoted to music, though often unaware of his own limitations. Strong comic instincts. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON VAN SWIETEN, 50 to 70 

Influential patron of the arts. Intellectual, dignified, and quietly authoritative. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT VON STRACK, 35 to 60 

Court official. Polished, ambitious, and committed to preserving decorum and tradition. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT ORSINI-ROSENBERG, 40 to 65 

Imperial Director of Opera. Conservative, politically savvy, and skeptical of artistic risk. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON WALSEGG, 40 to 65 

Wealthy aristocrat with a mysterious presence. Reserved and imposing. Role will also include Ensemble work.

Two VENTICELLI, 30 to 50 

The “Little Winds.” Nimble storytellers who provide gossip, exposition, and comic energy. Excellent timing and verbal dexterity required.

KATHERINA CAVALIERI, 20 to 40 

Celebrated soprano and former student of Salieri. Confident, poised, and accustomed to admiration. Classical singing ability welcome but not required. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

TERESA SALIERI, 40 to 60 

Salieri’s wife. Quiet, observant presence. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

ENSEMBLE

18+ To portray courtiers, servants, musicians, clergy, and opera performers. Strong ensemble skills and comfort with multiple roles. Singing and movement abilities a plus.

Title: Nuclear Supper

Genre: Music Video/Short film

Logline: A young woman travels through a post-apocalyptic land and encounters a supernatural group of revelers

Actress wanted to star in our second music video. This is for our song "Nuclear Supper". Looking for a young woman, late teens to 20's. Not set on a particular look beyond the wardrobe. You don't have to be a beauty queen...just appear resilient and determined in a post-apocalyptic world. Think "Mad Max"/Furiosa.
* no lines to learn
* non-paid/non-union
* meals provided
* Filming over 2-4 days, likely starting the evening of Tue October 13. Schedule still forming
* Filmed in Lafayette, Broomfield, Longmont
* Primarily outside. One interior scene

We have lined up a really awesome film crew. We will be looking for extras in a separate post, so if you like the look of the project and want a smaller commitment, let me know!

Contact me via Facebook or email ninewidesky@gmail.com. We're new at this, so ask any and all questions!

I have put together a story board on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qWkgwZHhykk

Band site:

https://www.ninewidesky.com/

I would love to be a part of this. Unfortunately I'm out of town 10/13 😭

items.summary:
We Bring the spirit of Africa to your European event's 🌍✨

We are available as from the end October Kenya African acrobats now based in Europe 
From high-energy flips to traditional rhythmic shows, we bring culture, power, and jaw-dropping stunts to:

✓ Christmas events
✓ Weddings & Festivals
✓ Brand activations & TV shows
✓ Private parties & Circus shows 
    

Available across Europe. Travel Expenses not included.
DM "FOR BOOKING"  for rates + showreel.

#AfricanAcrobats #EventEntertainment #EuropeEvents

CASTING CALL, paid, non-union. Toronto / GTA.

We're a small Canadian home wellness brand shooting a short commercial with a Toronto crew on Aug 29-30 (backup Sept 5-6). Interiors, no travel.

Looking for:

- Mother, 65-75. Speaks to camera, teleprompter provided. One day.

- Daughter, 45-55. Speaks to camera. Two half days.

- Friend, 60-75. No lines. Part day.

We're casting the mother and daughter as a pair. If you know someone who could pass as your mom or your daughter, apply together.

To apply, email ask@silvie.com with your role in the subject line:

- two recent photos, one headshot, one full length

- a 60-second phone video, natural, reading the line on the poster

- your rate, your city, and which weekend you can do

Everyone who sends a tape gets a reply.

CASTING CALL: A PAPARAZZI STORY (Short Film)

We're casting for A Paparazzi Story. The paparazzi business portrayed in a gangster style. A tabloid-noir slapstick dark comedy set in London, 2005, following two paparazzi as they chase the biggest story. Ending in complete disaster. 

The story will be directed by a 20-year-old director, who has already won the Manhattan Film Festival. 

This is a non-budget production. No pay, but we're offering a revenue share should the film generate any. The film is set to start a social media show and have selected cinema screenings. Plus, full credit and a professional reel-ready short for your portfolio.

Roles:

GÜNTER — 23, male. A dry, unbothered German who wanted to be an actor but had no talent, so he became a paparazzo. GERMAN SPEAKING IN CERTAIN SCENES

JESSICA — 24, female. A talented young musician with big dreams of her big break, — She falls in love with a paparazzo because he promised her to introduce her to a big producer.

JEAN-JACQUES — 25, male. A slick, hot-headed French paparazzo — sharp suit, sharper instincts, and a car he'd rather not have wrecked chasing someone else's story.

CHLOE — 32, female. She is a model and the girlfriend of George Clooney. The person the whole scoop is all about. 

BRITTANY — 27, female. She is also in the middle of the scandal. She is the woman George Clooney drunkenly married the night before. The paparazzi hunt her. 

SECURITY GUARD — 34, female. A security guard who's seen it all and just wants to get through the shift without a scene — but the paparazzi never make that easy.

JOURNALIST — 44, female. A journalist from The Sun newspaper. She is involved in the phone hacking scandal and gives the paparazzi the important tip.

JACQUELINE — 56, female. The head chef of a restaurant celebrities are dining at. She is corrupted by the paparazzi and lets them go through for some money. 

MRS. JOHNSON — 41, female. A corrupt police officer who gives the paparazzi the tip on where the celebrity is. She is the female version of Harvey Weinstein.

MRS. PUNTER — 43, female. She is the owner of the car the paparazzi steal. She gets furious and hunts them down to the end. 

 

We're looking for: actors comfortable with physical comedy and dark humor, available for rehearsals and a 1-2 day shoot in London (Günter 5 shoot days).

To apply: send a headshot, and a few words to Nils Bühler (Producer) at nilsbuehler@icloud.com. A short self tape scene will follow.

Shoot dates: Weekends and some weekdays in September and October
Location: London

**CASTING CALL - PAID PERFORMER**

**The Dreaming - Live Performance Art Project | Snape Maltings, Suffolk**

We are seeking an actor comfortable with emotional states, queerness, and physicality to take part in a live performance taking place in Suffolk this September/October.

**About the project**

This is an experimental performance that encompasses music, movement and poetry. We’re looking for an actor to perform alongside musicians and dancers. 

The piece is set on a roundabout - the kind you'd find in a children's playground. It explores a body that knows something is wrong before the mind can prove it, and a reality handed back, rearranged. When words fail, panic becomes the last language left - with everyone around to spectate.

The project is by Britten Pears Artist in Residence, Willow Hazell, an artist & filmmaker based in London. They have collaborated on projects exhibited at the Venice Biennale and the Serpentine Gallery. Their films have featured at Aesthetica Film Festival & on Nowness, and they work with clients such as Dazed, Tate & Philharmonia Orchestra. They are collaborating with Ivor Novello award-winning composer Ben Nobuto on this project. 

The rehearsals and performance will take place in Britten Studio at Snape Maltings.

**Who we're looking for**
* White male, middle-aged
* Actor, playing age approx. 40–60
* Comfortable working in emotional states (able to cry on cue is a bonus)
* Able to handle the physicality of the role, including pushing the roundabout
* Ideally based near Suffolk, but accepting applicants from neighbouring areas

**Audition**

Online audition to take place in August or early September.

**Pay - £700 total**
* £150 p/day 2× rehearsal days
* £200 1x filmed day
* £200 1x performance day

**Expenses**

Food, travel, and shared accommodation can be provided. Accommodation will be in Aldeburgh.

**Dates at Snape Maltings, Suffolk**
* Rehearsals: 29th & 30th September
* Film: 1st October
* Live performance: 2nd October

Please send links to showreels/spotlight pages to hello@willhazell.co.uk.

**CASTING: Kampania dla szwedzkiej marki karmy dla zwierząt**

Poszukujemy bohaterki wraz z pupilami do nagrania materiału wideo (Instagram Reel) dla szwedzkiego producenta karmy. Opcjonalnie poszukujemy włącznie z lokalizacją, urokliwym domem, w którym można zrealizować materiał.

**Kogo szukamy:**
* Kobiety w wieku 35–50 lat.
* Właścicielki **psa i kota (warunek konieczny)**, które żyją w zgodzie i lubią się nawzajem. W nagraniu wystąpią wszyscy.

**Szczegóły współpracy:**
* Lokalizacja: okolice Warszawy.
* Termin nagrań: wstępnie 15–30 września.
* Forma współpracy: umowa zlecenie lub umowa o dzieło (udział płatny).
* Zakres: pełne prawa do wizerunku i emisja w kampanii w mediach społecznościowych.

**Zgłoszenia:** Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać na adres: kontakt@menippe.pl lub w prywatnej wiadomości.

W treści maila prosimy zawrzeć:
1. Swoje zdjęcie lub portfolio.
2. Zdjęcia zwierząt.
3. Krótki opis (skąd jesteś, informacje o sobie i zwierzakach oraz szczegóły dotyczące ich relacji).
4. Wszelkie dodatkowe informacje, które mogą być istotne.
5. Numer telefonu do kontaktu.
6. Opcjonalnie: zdjęcia nieruchomości, przybliżona lokalizacja, opis.

FREUNDE 😛❤️!! Montag und wir geben Gas!! 🤪

🚔 Polizei-Aufbauworkshop mit Schießtraining 🔫🎬

Du hast bereits unseren DU BIST FILM Basis-Workshop absolviert oder verfügst über Erfahrung bei Polizei, Bundeswehr, Justiz, Sicherheitsdienst oder als Polizei-Komparse? Dann ist dieser exklusive Aufbauworkshop genau das Richtige für dich.

An zwei intensiven Trainingstagen trainierst du realitätsnahe Polizeiarbeit für Film- und Fernsehproduktionen – mit erfahrenen Ausbildern und professionellem Schießtraining.

📅 01.11.2026 | Dachau
📅 02.11.2026 | Schießanlage Oberschleißheim

🔥 Das erwartet dich:
👮 Authentische Polizeiarbeit vor der Kamera
✔ Personenkontrollen
✔ Durchsuchungen
✔ Fesselungstechniken
✔ Personentransport
✔ Kommunikation & taktisches Agieren
✔ Belastungstraining unter Stress

🔫 Waffenhandling
✔ Sicheres und authentisches Handling
✔ Bewegungsabläufe
✔ Taktisches Verhalten
✔ Realitätsnahe Einsatzszenarien

🥋 Selbstverteidigung
✔ Verhalten bei Angriffen
✔ Umgang mit aggressiven Personen
✔ Notwehr- und Nothilfe

🎯 Exklusives Schießtraining
Der zweite Workshoptag findet auf einer Schießanlage statt.

Jeder Teilnehmer erhält:
✅ ca. 45 Minuten reine Schießzeit
✅ 1:1-Coaching
✅ Betreuung durch zwei erfahrene Schießausbilder
✅ Kleine Trainingsgruppen
✅ Individuelles Feedback

⚠️ Das Schießtraining dient ausschließlich der sicheren Waffenhandhabung und dem realistischen Verständnis von Bewegungsabläufen für Film- und Fernsehproduktionen. Die Durchführung erfolgt ausschließlich unter Anleitung zertifizierter Schießausbilder.

👮 Trainer
Marcus M. – Polizeibeamter, Selbstverteidigungs- & Schießausbilder
Oliver H. – Ehem. Polizeibeamter, Schießausbilder & Ausbilder Waffensachkunde

📩 Interesse?
Dann sende deine verbindliche Anmeldung an info@komparse.tv und erhalte weitere Infos :).

Jede Anmeldung wird geprüft, da sich dieser Workshop ausschließlich an Teilnehmer mit entsprechenden Vorkenntnissen richtet.

⚠️ Die Teilnehmerzahl ist stark begrenzt!

Wir freuen uns auf dich ❤️.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋

Hello there! I’m beginning pre-production on an independent horror/thriller short film titled Alan Cartyr.

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

𝐀𝐁𝐎𝐔𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐉𝐄𝐂𝐓
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: October 2026, Dates TBD
Location: Denver–Colorado Springs, CO, Location TBD

This is currently an unpaid independent project, unless funding is secured really. My long-term goal is to build a consistent team of people to work on future projects intended for YouTube, film festivals, and other platforms.

Meals will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors. An additional day may be scheduled if needed for pickups or reshoots.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆

Doctor Alan
Age: Mid-20s–late 30s
Role: Lead

Doctor Alan is a bold and inquisitive man who possesses a strong sense of misplaced bravery but struggles to recognize where the line should be drawn when it comes to anyone other than himself. This role requires a performance that balances curiosity, tension, and fear.

Cartyr’s Father
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting
A supporting role appearing both off-screen and through silhouette work. This role requires strong physical acting and vocal performance, particularly the ability to portray painful anger through body language, posture, and vocal tonality.

Young Cartyr
Age: 8–15
Role: Supporting
A young version of Cartyr who appears on screen in a dedicated scene. The performance should convey something cold, distant, and hollow, with an emphasis on subtle expression and unsettling presence.

Young Woman
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting / Extra 
A heavily on-screen role requiring limited physical movement and a strong ability to communicate a display of her fearful desperation of freedom through facial expressions and body language.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖

Director: Evan “Vander” Moreland

Director of Photography (DP): Billy Causey

Producer: A producer is not absolutely required at this stage, but anyone interested in helping with production logistics or potentially assisting with funding is greatly appreciated.

1st AD: I will also be acting in the film, so I would greatly appreciate someone who can help keep production moving. Responsibilities may include keeping us on schedule, handling basic logistics, coordinating the set, and helping track continuity.

Sound Engineer / Boom Operator: Someone with experience recording clean dialogue and working with production sound would be greatly appreciated. Sound will be especially important to this project, as the film relies heavily on atmosphere, eerie sound design, silence, focus, and subtle audio details to build tension.
(A shotgun microphone and/or boom setup would also be extremely helpful.)

Gaffer
I’ve worked on too many films with my man Billy, and we always end up saying, “We really need a gaffer.” 
So… please help the guy and us out if you can! Someone who can help with lighting setups, equipment, lighting, etc.

SFX Makeup Artist: I have a few people in mind for this position, but collaborative efforts are always welcome. This is a very important role for the project, particularly with the practical wounds and effects involved. The position can potentially be shared.

Editor: An editor is not absolutely required at this stage, but if I can find an editor for post-production, it would be greatly appreciated and would help take some pressure off my plate.

CONTACT INFORMATION

If you’re interested in a cast or crew position, or simply want to help with the project in any capacity, feel free to comment, message, or (preferably) email:
morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

For Cast Applicants,
If you’re interested in a casting role, please submit your headshot, reel, and resume if you have them.

Official filming locations and dates will be announced soon. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you <3

Hello there! I’m beginning pre-production on an independent horror/thriller short film titled Alan Cartyr.

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

𝐀𝐁𝐎𝐔𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐉𝐄𝐂𝐓
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: October 2026, Dates TBD
Location: Denver–Colorado Springs, CO, Location TBD

This is currently an unpaid independent project, unless funding is secured really. My long-term goal is to build a consistent team of people to work on future projects intended for YouTube, film festivals, and other platforms.

Meals will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors. An additional day may be scheduled if needed for pickups or reshoots.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆

Doctor Alan
Age: Mid-20s–late 30s
Role: Lead

Doctor Alan is a bold and inquisitive man who possesses a strong sense of misplaced bravery but struggles to recognize where the line should be drawn when it comes to anyone other than himself. This role requires a performance that balances curiosity, tension, and fear.

Cartyr’s Father
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting
A supporting role appearing both off-screen and through silhouette work. This role requires strong physical acting and vocal performance, particularly the ability to portray painful anger through body language, posture, and vocal tonality.

Young Cartyr
Age: 8–15
Role: Supporting
A young version of Cartyr who appears on screen in a dedicated scene. The performance should convey something cold, distant, and hollow, with an emphasis on subtle expression and unsettling presence.

Young Woman
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Supporting / Extra 
A heavily on-screen role requiring limited physical movement and a strong ability to communicate a display of her fearful desperation of freedom through facial expressions and body language.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖

Director: Evan “Vander” Moreland

Director of Photography (DP): Billy Causey

Producer: A producer is not absolutely required at this stage, but anyone interested in helping with production logistics or potentially assisting with funding is greatly appreciated.

1st AD: I will also be acting in the film, so I would greatly appreciate someone who can help keep production moving. Responsibilities may include keeping us on schedule, handling basic logistics, coordinating the set, and helping track continuity.

Sound Engineer / Boom Operator: Someone with experience recording clean dialogue and working with production sound would be greatly appreciated. Sound will be especially important to this project, as the film relies heavily on atmosphere, eerie sound design, silence, focus, and subtle audio details to build tension.
(A shotgun microphone and/or boom setup would also be extremely helpful.)

Gaffer
I’ve worked on too many films with my man Billy, and we always end up saying, “We really need a gaffer.” 
So… please help the guy and us out if you can! Someone who can help with lighting setups, equipment, lighting, etc.

SFX Makeup Artist: I have a few people in mind for this position, but collaborative efforts are always welcome. This is a very important role for the project, particularly with the practical wounds and effects involved. The position can potentially be shared.

Editor: An editor is not absolutely required at this stage, but if I can find an editor for post-production, it would be greatly appreciated and would help take some pressure off my plate.

CONTACT INFORMATION

If you’re interested in a cast or crew position, or simply want to help with the project in any capacity, feel free to comment, message, or (preferably) email:
morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

For Cast Applicants,
If you’re interested in a casting role, please submit your headshot, reel, and resume if you have them.

Official filming locations and dates will be announced soon. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you <3

A Lesson in Professionalism
According to a recent account shared by casting director Monika Dalman, an actor was replaced after making a body-shaming comment about his female co-star during a table read. The individuals and production were not identified, but the professional lesson is worth discussing:

Talent may get you hired. Respect, maturity, and professionalism help keep you working.

Every performer deserves a workplace where they are treated with dignity. For young actors especially, learning how to treat cast and crew matters just as much as learning lines.

Read the room. Respect your scene partners. Be someone people want to work with again.

#StarsInTheirEyes #ActorLife #SetEtiquette #Professionalism #YoungActors #TalentIndustry #IndustrySafety #ParentsOfYoungPerformers

items.text:
# **BLIV EN DEL AF ONDT**

 

Til efteråret præsenterer **Teltet på Bakken** og **Dystopia Entertainment** horrorforestillingen **ONDT** – en ny, intens og anderledes teateroplevelse, hvor publikum træder direkte ind i fortællingen.

 

Vi søger nu frivillige medvirkende, der har lyst til at blive en del af et ambitiøst, professionelt  og kreativt fællesskab. Rollerne er ulønnede, men til gengæld bliver du en vigtig del af en professionel teaterproduktion og er med til at skabe noget, ingen har oplevet før.

 

Som medvirkende bliver du en del af et unikt kunstnerisk fællesskab, hvor frivillige medvirkende, professionelle skuespillere og instruktørerne **Henrik Grimbäck** og **Christina Neumann Jensen** sammen skaber ONDT – fra de første prøver til den sidste forestilling.

I **ONDT** er publikum ikke blot tilskuere – de befinder sig midt i forestillingen. Du bliver en del af det univers, der omgiver dem, og er med til at skabe de øjeblikke, de husker længe efter, de har forladt teltet.

 

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med teater. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde fysisk, være tæt på publikum og indgå i et stærkt ensemble, hvor alle bidrager til den samlede oplevelse.

 

**HVILKEN ROLLE PASSER TIL DIG?**

 

**WILDCARDET**

Kan du lidt af det hele? Du har god energi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab. Vi leder efter mennesker med nysgerrighed, engagement og lyst til at kaste sig ud i noget nyt.

 

**SNIGERNE**

Er du gymnast, parkourudøver, danser eller har du exceptionel kropskontrol? Du kravler, sniger dig og bevæger dig lydløst gennem mørket. Du er der, hvor publikum mindst forventer det.

 

**MONSTRENE**

Du har en stærk fysisk udstråling og tør bruge hele kroppen til at skabe frygt. Store bevægelser, intensitet og nærvær er vigtigere end replikker.

 

**LOKKEDUERNE**

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

 

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **[ondt@dystopia.dk](mailto:ondt@dystopia.dk)**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

 

**Senest d.14/8**

 

**FORLØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

 

**August**
* 17., 20. og 27. august (eftermiddag/aften)

 

**September**

 
* 2., 9., 11., 15. og 16. september (eftermiddag/aften)
   1. september kl. 10.00–14.00
* Daglige prøver fra 20. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

 

**SPILLEPERIODE**

 

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

 

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

 

[[https://dystopia.dk/](https://dystopia.dk/)](https://dystopia.dk/)

Du ligner en helt almindelig gæst. Du griner, hygger dig og falder naturligt ind blandt publikum – indtil stemningen pludselig ændrer sig. Rollen kræver nærvær og troværdighed.

**OFRET**

Det hele begynder med dig. Du kan skabe ægte frygt og få publikum til at holde vejret. Rollen kræver nærvær, mod og evnen til at give sig fuldt ud.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldigt ensemble og opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge. Har du et særligt talent, en usædvanlig fysik eller en færdighed, som kunne passe ind i ONDTs univers, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

**INTERESSERET?**

Skriv til **ondt@dystopia.dk**

Fortæl lidt om dig selv, vedhæft gerne et billede, og skriv, hvorfor du har lyst til at blive en del af ONDT. Har du særlige færdigheder eller erfaring med bevægelse, dans, gymnastik, parkour, performance eller lignende, må du meget gerne fortælle om det.

**Senest d.14/8**

**FORELØBIG PRØVEPERIODE**

**August**
* 24. august - introaften (eftermiddag/aften)

**September**
* 6., 9., 16., 17. og 18. september (eftermiddag/aften)
* Daglige prøver fra 21. september frem til premieren den 25. september.

**SPILLEPERIODE**

**25. september – 1. november 2026**

Se spilledage på:
**billet.cirkusrevyen.dk**

**Vi søger ikke bare medvirkende. Vi søger mennesker, der har lyst til at skabe noget helt særligt sammen med os.**

MUSICAL-AUDITION NU PÅ FREDAG! 🎭 
Du kan stadig nå det! Skuespillere, sangere og dansere søges til Musicalteatrets næste to forestillinger, skrevet af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical”, “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical” og mange flere). Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu!

“JULEGÅDEN OM JULEGRØDEN”
Musicalteatrets seneste, årlige julemusical for hele familien!
Auditiondato: Fredag d. 21. august 2026.
Der søges (køn/alder): 10 skuespillere/sangere i alle køn og aldre fra 16 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav).
Øveperiode: 3. september – 27. november 2026 på Frederiksberg.
Spilledatoer/spillested: 28. november – 20. december 2026 i KU•BE på Frederiksberg.
OBS: Alle roller er hovedroller, og alle roller har solosang.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Genopsætning af Musicalteatrets storsælgende, anmelderroste thrillermusical fra 2019!
Auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 12.-13. september 2026.
Der søges (køn/alder): 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller danser i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav). 
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027 på Frederiksberg.
Spilledatoer/spillested: 3.-20. marts 2027 på Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er også muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i “Jack the Ripper: The Musical”.

items.text:
Hello everyone,

My name is Rodrigo Alves, and I am a performer, actor, dancer, and theatre-maker based in London.

Originally from Brazil, my artistic journey has taken me through Brazil, Spain, and the UK, where I have trained and worked in dance, physical theatre, movement, acting, and performance-making. I recently graduated with a **First Class Honours degree in Theatre and Performance** and was honoured to receive the **Award for Artistic Excellence in Theatre and Performance**.

My approach as a performer is deeply inspired by nature. I see adaptation as one of the most important qualities of both life and performance. Nature constantly evolves, listens, responds, and works in harmony with its environment. In the same way, I enjoy building performances through collaboration, ensemble work, and genuine human connection.

As an actor and performer, I am interested in physical storytelling, emotional honesty, improvisation, transformation, and creating work that connects body, imagination, and experience. I enjoy collaborating with artists who value curiosity, experimentation, and meaningful creative processes.

I am currently looking to connect and collaborate with filmmakers, directors, producers, actors, dancers, choreographers, photographers, musicians, visual artists, theatre-makers, writers, and other creatives interested in developing films, theatre productions, dance projects, music videos, performances, installations, and interdisciplinary work.

If you'd like to collaborate, create something together, or simply connect, I'd love to hear from you.

Rodrigo Alves
London, UK

☎️  AUDITION CALL! 

🌻 CALENDAR GIRLS By Tim Firth 🌻

✨ Producer Mike Jewison
✨ Director Dinah Watts
✨ Co-Director Cassandra Allen

📚 ABOUT THE PLAY: 
Calendar Girls is a critically acclaimed, heartwarming comedy-drama based on a true story. It features a group of middle-aged women who pose tastefully nude for a charity calendar to honor a lost loved one. A perfect balance of hilarity, poignant grief, and body positivity. (There are also parts for men and young women.) (This will be fun!!!!)
Full length play in two acts.

📆 AUDITION DATES:
Saturday, October 3 - 1:30 to 4:30 pm
Wednesday, October 7 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
Friday, October 9 - 6:30 to 9:30 pm
CALL BACKS: Saturday October 17 - 2:00 to 4:00 pm

PERFORMANCE DATES: April 29 to May 9, 2027

REHEARSALS: To start Mid-January, 2027

✅ AUDITION REQUIREMENTS:
Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue. Keep it short and sassy – and we may ask you to read from the script. NO ACCENTS REQUIRED. If invited to callbacks, you will be asked to read/enact selected sides from the play alongside fellow auditioners.

📩 HOW TO SUBMIT: 
Please visit our Audition page on our website (🔗 in comments) for the full character breakdown, and send your audition request to Dinah at: calendargirlsauditions [at] gmail [dot] com

items.text:
Greetings! My name is Paul Head, and I’m a Los Angeles-based non-scripted Casting Director. You can view my credits and credentials at www.pauldhead.com. I’m currently casting a premium documentary series for a major cable network exploring an often-unspoken experience.

We’re looking nationwide for people whose spouse or long-term life partner suddenly and unexpectedly left, vanished, or ghosted them without explanation—including people who are still legally married but don’t know where their husband or wife is. 

We’re specifically seeking people who are not currently in communication with their partner, don’t know where they are, don’t understand why they left, and have been unable to find them on their own.

The series offers expert help in finding answers, gaining clarity, and hopefully getting the closure you’ve been looking for.

This is a paid documentary series featuring real people and real, ongoing situations.

If this sounds like you or someone you know, we’d like to hear from you. We’re casting nationwide now! To apply and for more information: casting@bodegapictures.com

CASTING CALL FOR TOURING PANTO
Delighted to announce that we are casting for our brand-new touring pantomime, SLEEPING BEAUTY! 👑✨

We’re looking for versatile, energetic performers to join our professional cast for a magical Christmas tour, bringing the pantomime experience directly to primary school audiences across the region 🎭

👑 ROLES AVAILABLE

• Beauty

• Morpeth / Prince

• King

Please note: all roles are multi-role and performers must be confident playing multiple characters throughout the production.

📅 AUDITIONS: 22 September 2026

🎭 REHEARSALS: Late November / early December

✨ TOUR DATES: 4–18 December 2026 (EXACT DATES TBC) 

To be considered and to read our audition information pack, please send your headshot and CV to:

📩 kim@mimictheatre.co.uk

We’re looking for performers with great stage presence, strong comedy skills and the versatility to bring multiple characters to life in a fast-paced touring panto!

Please note, if you are unable to make the audition date, we’d still like to hear from you. 

Deadline to apply: 15th Sept 26

Fource is looking for two new members to join our global girl group.

AUDITIONS
Applicants must be 18+.
Submit your audition here:
https://forms.gle/TqzVJZ2rsbizgWQ77

ABOUT FOURCE
Fource is an independent global girl group based in the United States that follows the K-Pop system. We create and perform original music and choreography.
Our concept is centered around the five elements: Water, Earth, Fire, Air, and Spirit.
We are currently casting for the Air and Fire elements.

Personality: Bubbly, energetic, and “sunshine”
Preferred Vocal Range: Mid Alto to High Soprano
Preferred Role: Main Rapper / Main Dancer
Inspirations: Rei Ami, Tate McRae, Sabrina Carpenter, Lisa, Rosé, Yuki, Yeji, Rei

**URGENT LOS ANGELES CASTING — BLACK BOY, AGES 10–14**

Hey everyone, my name is Dayna Iniguez and I’m helping with casting for an independent short film, directed by Los Angeles filmmaker Reginald “Reggie” Hughes. We shoot **this Sunday, August 23**, so this is an **urgent casting search** trying to fill one remaining youth role. We are looking for a **Black boy around 10–14 years old **to play MAN-MAN, a small but pivotal supporting role.

**What we’re looking for:**
• Comfortable taking direction
• Acting experience is **not required**
• Parent/guardian involvement is required

**Compensation:** Unpaid
**Provided:** Meals, screen credit, and footage

This is a small independent narrative production with a professional crew, open to first-time performers. If you have a son, nephew, younger brother, cousin, student, athlete, or know **any Black boy ages 10–15 who may be interested**, please **tag/share this with their parent or guardian**.

Interested parents/guardians can **message me directly**, and I can connect you with Reggie and send over the script, character information, schedule, and full production details.

**Director:** Reginald “Reggie” Hughes
**Director's Portfolio:** https://www.reggiehughesportfolio.org/
**Director's Linkedin: **https://www.linkedin.com/in/reggie-hughes-38131a263/

Jodi Purdy Casting Director sharing for Paul D Head!

Greetings! My name is Paul Head, and I’m a Los Angeles-based non-scripted Casting Director. You can view my credits and credentials at www.pauldhead.com. I’m currently casting a premium documentary series for a major cable network exploring an often-unspoken experience.

We’re looking nationwide for people whose spouse or long-term life partner suddenly and unexpectedly left, vanished, or ghosted them without explanation—including people who are still legally married but don’t know where their husband or wife is. 

We’re specifically seeking people who are not currently in communication with their partner, don’t know where they are, don’t understand why they left, and have been unable to find them on their own.

The series offers expert help in finding answers, gaining clarity, and hopefully getting the closure you’ve been looking for.

This is a paid documentary series featuring real people and real, ongoing situations.

If this sounds like you or someone you know, we’d like to hear from you. We’re casting nationwide now! To apply and for more information: casting@bodegapictures.com

**CASTING CALL - SHORT STUDENT FILM - NON-UNION**

**Shoot Date: **Sunday Aug 23rd**, **2026

**Location: **East Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:** Non-paid (volunteer)

We're casting two middle-aged men and two middle-aged woman to be in our short film. 

**Synopsis: **They're bored, so they found something to do. Maya and Daniel have something to hide, and so do Sophie and Alex. Between secret meetings and charged innuendos, one secret binds them all together. 

## Roles:
1. **Maya (Female, 35-50): **Maya is the witty and introverted English teacher who is exceptionally good at her newfound talent, miming. 
2. **Sophie (Female, 35-50): **Sophie is the cool, calm and collected art teacher** **whose sharp as a whip. She's oftentimes bored, and is looking for something fun to do to spice up her life. (May have to smoke a fake cigarette)
3. **Daniel (Male, 35-50): **Daniel is the macho man. Think cool gym teacher with an ego. He enjoys teasing others and is a bit of a goof ball. 
4. **Alex (Male, 35-50): **Alex is an anxious chemistry teacher who DREADS keeping secrets. He is, however, determined to impress Maya with his skills. 

**Please submit your CV and reel to auditions@kyliehatton.com using subject line: FATAL ATTRACTION - (Role) - (Your name).**

**Communication done through email ONLY**

**Additional Info:**
* Information about rehearsal will be communicated to you
* Sophies role may have to smoke a fake cigarette

Looking forward to potentially working with you :)

Hier das Video zum Testdreh: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fKmxXKsP3cQ

**Zeitraum:** 1 Drehtag im Zeitraum 30.08. bis 08.09. (ggf. auch unter der Woche)
**Location:** Bodensee/ Raum Ravensburg
**Gage:** No-Budget. Das Projekt darf natürlich für das eigene Showreel verwendet werden
**Reisekosten:** werden nach Absprache übernommen
Für ausreichend Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt.

sharedPost.text:
We’re looking for actors to take part in R Online Read series!🦜

Join our virtual table read of a brand new play, destined for the stage.👩‍💻

🎭 Next up for R 2026 series, we have the bold and powerful new play ‘Boys Who Dance’ by Grant Corr. When developing minds with nothing to do, navigating self-discovery, and desperate for a place to belong are surrounded by the thick air of mob mentality, a lie can spread like wildfire. 

Set in Belfast, this beautifully written play tackles extremely sensitive and topical themes with great thought and heart. ❤️ If you are an actor and want to help bring this wonderful script to life, check out the breakdown below before booking your spot. 

⭐Character breakdown:
Charlie Straw: Male, 16, Northern Irish. Part-time shop assistant. He is shy, confused and still discovering his sexuality.
Val (Farishta) Fitzpatrick: Female, 50’s, South Asian.  She fled Afghanistan decades ago and reinvented herself in East Belfast, where she has quietly run a small suburban pet shop for twenty-five years.
Linda Mooney: Female, 18, Northern Irish. Part-time shop assistant. She is sharp-tongued, ambitious and restless for a life beyond the shop.
Rafi Zahir: Male, 19, South Asian, Afghan refugee. Nephew of Val, he is warm and charming but carries the traumas of his past.
Noreen Lemon: Female, 16-19, Northern Irish. A friend of Charlie’s.

📅 Taking place online, on the 30th of August @ 6:30pm (BST)

Find a link in our bio to join in or learn more 👆 

#Rcreatives #OnlineReadings #Playwright #Actor #actors #ActorsWanted #ActingLife

🌀🎬🎥🌚 Exclusive Acting Workshop – Final Version .version A.

💡 Value Highlight: Learn directly from a DP/Director whose professional rate is $1,500/day 

this 4-session online workshop gives you real film-level expertise at a fraction of that cost!
Price on enquiry.

VERY LOW COST: One-on-One Online via Skype
"This course integrates the poetic realism of Tarkovsky, the practical wisdom of Michael Caine, and the transformative techniques of Stanislavski and Method Acting. Designed to deepen your craft, it focuses on authentic emotional connection and powerful storytelling."

🎬 Created by a British Cinematographer/Director with 31 Years of Experience and 32 Features to His Name
🌐 International Experience: Having worked on films worldwide, collaborating with actors and directors, I bring real-world insights from both sides of the camera. This course is designed to give actors a deep understanding of their craft, emphasizing emotional depth and character development.

🌐 IMDb: www.imdb.com/name/nm1806508

🌐 Showreel: https://enkiproductions1.8b.io

🤔 What You Will Learn:

🌀 Emotional Range: Master the ability to express a full spectrum of emotions, making your performances more believable and compelling.

🌀 Character Development: Create rich, multidimensional characters by exploring their internal world, external actions, and backstory.

🌀 Method Acting: Use personal experiences and emotions to deliver raw, authentic performances.

🌀 Working with Directors and Crew: Learn how to hit marks, understand shooting ratios, and collaborate with crew members to enhance your performance.

🌀 Scene Preparation: Techniques for script interpretation, emotional connection, and performing under pressure.

🌀 Industry Standards: How to create a professional showreel and work effectively with casting directors and filmmakers.
🎬 Day 1: Moment-to-Moment Acting (Stanislavski’s Approach).

🔹 Breaking a Scene Down: The use of internal visualization and meditation to "become" the character.

Character Exercise: The Hitman’s First Kill
📍 Scene: A low-rent hotel room in Manhattan, lit by a dull winter’s midday light. The sad hum of a ceiling fan, distant sirens, muted traffic below. On the bed—a brand-new sniper rifle.

🔹 Exercise 1 (Singular Emotion): Enter the room, pick up the gun, examine it, and prepare for the target. Remain fully in character.

🔹 Exercise 2 (Multiple Emotional Shifts):
Enter slightly out of breath, feeling relief—"I made it here. No one saw me."
The weight of reality sets in—"Am I really about to kill someone?"
Mesmerized by the artistry of the gun—draw on memories of seeing/touching weapons.
Snapped back to reality by a siren—trace the feeling of waking from a dream.
Decision made—move to the window, set up the gun, and wait.

🔹 Discussion: How do actors like Heath Ledger, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Dustin Hoffman make their characters so real? Insights from my own experiences on set with actors who never broke character—even during dinner.

Exercise 3 (If Time Allows): The Phone Call
📍 Scene: You’ve done something terrible—enough to make the person you love most leave forever. You must convince them to stay.

🎭 Goal: Improvise, using pure emotional truth, until the performance is undeniably real.

🎬 Day 2: Making Your Character Believable
🔹 Understanding the Psyche: Whether playing a killer or an ordinary person, you must know your character’s mind.

Character Exercise: The Breaking Point
📍 Scene: A crowded supermarket. A tired voice announces deals over the PA. You feel unseen, unheard, frustrated—until suddenly, you’re holding an AK-47. (Note: These scenes are purely acting exercises. They can be altered if a student is uncomfortable.)

🔹 Alternative Scene: A character about to detonate a bomb, written in the style of Heath Ledger’s Joker.

🔹 Alternative Scene: A video call to the person you love most—telling them why. (Scripted or improv.)

📍 Final Monologue Exercise: "Hi everyone… Tomorrow’s going to be different." The last words before an irreversible decision

🔹 Accents: Versatility in performance—working with British, American (Deep South), and Northern Irish accents.

🔹 Final Exercise: The Power of Stillness—sit before the camera, smiling, at total peace. Convey pure serenity.

🎬 Day 3: Working with a Director and Crew
🔹 Understanding Your Role: How an actor fits into the filmmaking process.

🔹 Hitting Marks & Lighting: The technical side of making performances shine.

🔹 Shooting Ratios: How they affect your performance.

🔹 Crew Collaboration: Understanding continuity, sound, makeup, cinematography, and direction.
Final Showreel Scenes (Day 3):

🎭 Sinister: "So you really think you got away with it? You really think that?" (Improv)

🎭 Heartbroken: "But I didn’t mean it... please, please, don’t leave me…" (Improv)

🎭 Insane (Joker-like): "Mmm... if E = mc², then time versus chaos... who cares?" (Improv)

🎭 Flat & Emotionless: "We’re born, we live, we die. That’s it." (Improv)
🔹 Goal: Draw from personal experiences and trace memories to make the performances deeply real.

🎬 Day 4: Fear and Survival – Personal Experience & Character Creation

🔹 Deep Dive: Exploring fear, survival, and desperation in character work.

Exercise 1: The Jungle Escape
📍 Scene: You’re lost in the jungle at night, exhausted, your breath the only sound. Every step is agony, but stopping means death. You call out—pleading for help. No answer.

🎭 Emotions to Explore:
Fear of death – the realization that no one is coming.
Desperation – the raw instinct to survive.
Physical exhaustion – feeling your body give in.

🎭 Method Process:
Internal Visualization – Close your eyes, hear the insects, the rustling leaves, your pounding heartbeat.

Personal Connection – Recall a moment when you felt completely lost or afraid.
Scene Execution – Let the emotions guide your body and voice.

Exercise 2: The Phone Call Redux
📍 Scene: You’re on the phone with a loved one. You need their help. If they refuse, it’s over. What do you say? What do you leave out?

🎭 Objective: Make the desperation feel real. This is life or death.

Final Performance (Day 4):
Students will perform a final emotional scene, bringing together everything they’ve learned. These performances will be recorded as raw material for their showreel.

🎬🎥 Ready to Elevate Your Acting?
This isn’t just a class—it’s an intense, immersive experience that will change the way you act forever.

🌐 To Enroll: p.m.me or e.mail:
mikeenkiproductions1@gmail.com
Let’s create something unforgettable.

[WSPÓŁPRACA / VFX / CLEAN-UP] 
Szybki retusz 3 ujęć do projektu filmowego (Creditsy / Portfolio)

Cześć wszystkim! 🎬

Pracuję obecnie nad projektem filmowym realizowanym we współpracy z 9Liter Filmy. W obsadzie projektu pojawiają się m.in. Nullizmatyk (Trzeci Wymiar), Akash (dawniej AK-47) oraz wielu innych artystów.

Projekt niestety mocno przekroczył pierwotnie zakładany budżet i nie mam możliwości zaoferowania stawki finansowej, ale gwarantuję wpis do napisów końcowych (creditsy), co przy tak rozpoznawalnych nazwiskach będzie mocnym i wartościowym punktem do portfolio.

Szukam kogoś, kto pomógłby przy postprodukcji/clean-upie zaledwie 3 krótkich ujęć:

• Ujęcie 1 (~3 sekundy): Prosty clean-up – usunięcie 3 współczesnych elementów niepasujących do epoki (naklejki/napisy w szybie drzwi).

• Ujęcie 2 (~8 sekund): Zamazanie / zblurowanie zawartości zielonej tabliczki nad przejściem.

• Ujęcie 3 (~3 sekundy, nieco bardziej wymagające): Wygładzenie zagięcia/fałdy na karku powstałej na masce lateksowej (retusz / tracking).

Do posta załączam stopklatki z zaznaczonymi miejscami.

Chętnych zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej – podeślę surówki w pełnej jakości i obgadamy szczegóły! Dzięki z góry za pomoc! 🙌

• Ujęcie 2 (~8 sekund): Zamazanie / zblurowanie zawartości zielonej tabliczki nad przejściem.

• Ujęcie 3 (~3 sekundy, nieco bardziej wymagające): Wygładzenie zagięcia/fałdy na karku powstałej na masce lateksowej (retusz / tracking).

Do posta załączam stopklatki z zaznaczonymi miejscami.

Chętnych zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej – podeślę surówki w pełnej jakości i obgadamy szczegóły! Dzięki z góry za pomoc! 🙌

# WROCŁAW I OKOLICE

Zaczynamy produkcję nowego sezonu **Trudnych Spaw** w Polot Media co oznacza, że szukamy nowych aktorów! Proszę o uważne przeczytanie charakterystyki i wieku postaci - zgłoszenia kompletnie niezgodne z rolą nie będą rozpatrywane.

Zgłoszenia dla osób z ***WROCŁAWIA LUB WOJEWÓDZTWA DOLNOŚLĄSKIEGO***:

**Lech Bednarski (wiek kandydata od 34 do 39 lat)** – archeolog. Dobrze wykształcony, zafascynowany swoją pracą. Karierowicz. Ma temperament choleryczny, jest bardzo porywczy, zazdrosny i arogancki. Lekceważy uczucia żony, bywa grubiański. Ubiera się nieformalnie. 

2 sceny

Płatność gotówką od razu po planie, ceny ustalane w zależności od roli. Osoby zainteresowane proszę o wysłanie wiadomości o tytule "Trudne Sprawy + LECH" wraz z:
* **aktualnymi** zdjęciami twarzy i sylwetki,
* wiekiem,
* wzrostem i wagą,
* numerem telefonu,
* materiałami video z odcinków, w których występowałeś/aś (jeżeli grałeś/aś w przeszłości)

na maila julia.lisowiec@polotmedia.pl.

Proszę o kontakt WYŁĄCZNIE osoby dyspozycyjne w podanych terminach, w podanym przedziale wiekowym oraz pochodzącym z odpowiedniej lokalizacji.

Spot reklamowy / Video promocyjne
Do nowego projektu reklamowego (promocja limitowanej kolekcji odzieżowej) poszukujemy 2 bohaterów (kobieta i mężczyzna).

POSZUKIWANE POSTACIE:

 DZIEWCZYNA: Wiek 18-35 lat. Ciekawa, "international" uroda, fotogeniczna. Wymagana wysoka elastyczność ciała, plastyka ruchu oraz doświadczenie w choreografii / tańcu / fashion pose.

 CHŁOPAK: Wiek 18-35 lat. Ciekawa, "international" uroda, charyzmatyczny. Wymagana wysoka elastyczność ciała, plastyka ruchu oraz doświadczenie w choreografii / tańcu / fashion pose.

SZCZEGÓŁY PROJEKTU:

 Miejsce zdjęć: Warszawa

 Data zdjęć: 1 dzień w przedziale 7–13 września

 Czas pracy: ok.5-6 godzin (pół dnia zdjęciowego)

 Pola eksploatacji: Digital / Social Media + krótki pokaz (intro) na konferencjach branżowych

 Okres licencji: 3–6 miesięcy

 Wynagrodzenie - 300 euro (za dzień zdjęciowy + prawa)

JAK ZGŁOSIĆ UDZIAŁ?

Chętne osoby prosimy o przesłanie zgłoszenia na adres e-mail: tatianamakhdi@gmail.com 

Tytyl - PIN UP 

W zgłoszeniu należy podać:

1. Imię, nazwisko, wiek, numer telefonu oraz wzrost .

2. 3–4 aktualne zdjęcia 

3. Krótkie wideo (Self-tape / Demo): pokazujące plastykę ciała, ruch fashion lub krótką improwizację taneczną/rozciąganie (max 30-40 sekund).

4. Link do Instagrama / Portfolio (jeśli posiadasz).
